title: The Turner Diaries
author: William Luther Pierce
current_text: Canada Customs classified The Turner Diaries as hate literature and issued an import prohibition in July 1996. The Turner Diaries was banned in Germany in April 2006.

sources.quote: Update— Canada Customs has never allowed the book into Canada, having stopped it at the border half a dozen times. Since the new edition came out with a mainstream publisher, Canada Customs reviewed the book and classified it as hate literature. The import prohibition was issued in July 1996

ban_rows.note: Canada Customs reviewed the new mainstream edition, classified it as hate literature and issued an import prohibition in July 1996; earlier copies had been stopped at the border (Freedom to Read).
The Turner Diaries was made illegal in France in 1999 due to its advocacy of racism, antisemitism, and the use of violence.
Placed on the BPjM index in Germany in April 2006 (German Wikipedia, citing a 2007 federal government answer and Boersenblatt 2006).
